patches.reason: Pinned Inochi2D v0.8.7 serializes Part.blend_mode as an integral enum but deserializes it as a string, preventing genuine Part-containing puppets produced by inWriteINPPuppet from being reopened for M1 real-artifact inspection.
patches.removalCondition: Remove when the pinned upstream revision can round-trip its own Part.blend_mode output without this compatibility patch.

patches.reason: Pinned Inochi2D v0.8.7 JSON deserialization treats nulib nstring as a D string and uses cast(T)data.str, bypassing nstring ownership/copy semantics and leaving metadata/node names backed by transient JSON memory after inLoadPuppet returns.
patches.removalCondition: Remove when the pinned upstream revision deserializes nulib nstring values through an owning constructor/assignment and loaded strings remain valid after JSON parser storage is released.

patches.reason: Pinned Inochi2D v0.8.7 passes nulib nstring directly to std.uni.toLower when rebuilding Parameter.indexableName; the alias conversion reaches std.uni with invalid range behavior for loaded parameter names. Passing the owned D-string view explicitly preserves the same lowercase semantics without the bounds failure.
patches.removalCondition: Remove when the pinned upstream revision can finalize a loaded Parameter with nstring names without a std.uni bounds failure.

patches.reason: Pinned Inochi2D v0.8.7 duplicates PuppetMeta serialization inside Puppet.onSerialize and assigns nulib nstring values directly into std.json, so whole-puppet JSON loses metadata even though PuppetMeta.onSerialize itself is corrected. Serialize the duplicated fields from their stable D-string views.
patches.removalCondition: Remove when the pinned upstream revision serializes Puppet metadata through one nstring-safe path and inToJson(Puppet) preserves metadata strings without this compatibility patch.

patches.reason: Pinned Inochi2D v0.8.7 serializes vec2 arrays such as MeshData verts/uvs as nested JSON arrays, while the generic vector-array deserializer assumes a flat float array and calls get!float on each nested array. Accept the serializer's nested representation while retaining the legacy flat-vector path.
patches.removalCondition: Remove when the pinned upstream revision can round-trip non-empty MeshData vec2 arrays produced by its own serializer without this compatibility patch.

patches.reason: Pinned Inochi2D v0.8.7 routes all scalar tryGet values through JSONValue.get!float, so uint sentinel values such as Part.NO_TEXTURE (4294967295) lose precision and reload as texture slot 0, incorrectly duplicating albedo into emissive and bumpmap. Integral scalar reads must use JSON integer/uinteger accessors.
patches.removalCondition: Remove when the pinned upstream revision preserves full signed/unsigned integer precision in serde tryGet and Part texture NO_TEXTURE sentinels round-trip without becoming slot 0.

patches.reason: Pinned Inochi2D v0.8.7 initializes Parameter.bindings as a JSON array but appends each serialized binding with JSONValue ~= JSONValue, whose std.json overload expects an array RHS and throws 'JSONValue is not an array'. Append the serialized binding object to the array storage explicitly.
patches.removalCondition: Remove when the pinned upstream revision can serialize a Parameter containing a ValueParameterBinding without std.json array-type failure.

patches.reason: Pinned Inochi2D v0.8.7 calls obj.tryGet!string(guidKey) inside tryGetGUID. Because serde also has a tryGet(T)(JSONValue, T defaultValue) overload, a string guidKey binds as the default-value overload rather than the keyed lookup and valid serialized GUID strings deserialize as nil UUIDs. Passing an explicit null default selects the keyed overload and preserves node/binding identity.
patches.removalCondition: Remove when the pinned upstream revision resolves string GUID fields through an unambiguous keyed JSON lookup and non-root node GUIDs survive whole-puppet round-trip without this patch.

patches.reason: Pinned Inochi2D v0.8.7 serializes ParameterBinding target GUIDs under the string field 'node' but deserializes with tryGetGUID('node','target'), where the first argument is reserved for a legacy numeric UUID key and the second for the string GUID key. As a result the valid 'node' string is skipped and the binding is removed during Parameter.finalize. Read legacy numeric 'target' first and current string 'node' second.
patches.removalCondition: Remove when the pinned upstream revision deserializes the same binding target field it serializes and a non-root ValueParameterBinding survives whole-puppet save/reopen without this patch.

patches.reason: Pinned Inochi2D v0.8.7 Node.onSerialize writes the node's z-sort float into the 'transform' field instead of serializing localTransform. Its own permissive JSON loader masks this by defaulting the transform, but official Inochi Creator v0.8.6 rejects the malformed transform while opening even a minimal real puppet. Serialize the actual local transform object so the emitted standard Inochi schema is structurally compatible.
patches.removalCondition: Remove when the pinned upstream revision serializes Node.localTransform into the 'transform' field itself and official Creator can open a minimal puppet without this compatibility patch.

patches.reason: Official Inochi Creator v0.8.6 predates Inochi2D's 2025 GUID migration and its node schema serializes/loads numeric 'uuid' identities, while pinned v0.8.7 emits only string 'guid'. Emit a stable legacy 32-bit projection alongside the GUID so older official Creator can resolve the required node identity without weakening the v0.8.7 GUID path.
patches.removalCondition: Remove when the supported official Creator version consumes the GUID node schema directly, or when pinned upstream provides its own backward-compatible legacy node identity emission.

patches.reason: Emitting both modern string 'guid' and compatibility numeric 'uuid' for Creator v0.8.6 exposes pinned v0.8.7 tryGetGUID precedence: it prefers the legacy uuid and replaces the node's original GUID with a projected legacy GUID, while parameter bindings still reference the original GUID. Prefer the modern GUID whenever both are present and retain uuid as a fallback for genuinely legacy files.
patches.removalCondition: Remove when the pinned upstream revision preserves modern GUID identity when both GUID and legacy UUID fields are present, or when legacy UUID emission is no longer required by the supported Creator compatibility target.

patches.reason: Official Inochi Creator v0.8.6 requires numeric Parameter.uuid values and numeric ParameterBinding.node targets, while pinned v0.8.7 emits modern string GUID identities. Emit the legacy parameter uuid alongside guid and encode bindings with numeric node plus modern string target so Creator v0.8.6 can load them while patched v0.8.7 preserves exact GUID identity.
patches.removalCondition: Remove when the supported official Creator version consumes GUID parameter/binding identities directly, or when pinned upstream provides backward-compatible dual identity serialization itself.

patches.reason: Official Inochi Creator v0.8.6 deserializes MeshData verts/uvs as the legacy flat scalar representation (x,y,x,y...), while pinned Inochi2D v0.8.7 generic vec2[] serialization emits nested arrays. Texture-only puppets open in Creator but the first real Part fails in FGHJ mesh decoding. Emit the standard legacy flat mesh-vector representation while keeping the v0.8.7 loader tolerant of both flat and nested arrays.
patches.removalCondition: Remove when the supported official Creator version accepts nested vec2 mesh arrays directly, or when pinned upstream emits a mesh representation that both its own loader and the supported Creator compatibility target consume without this patch.

patches.reason: Official Inochi Creator v0.8.6 indexes Part.mask_threshold unconditionally during FGHJ deserialization, while pinned Inochi2D v0.8.7 removed the field from Part serialization. Base, hierarchy, and texture-only puppets open successfully, but the first Part fails with EmptyFghjException. Emit the legacy default value 0.5 as a compatibility field without reintroducing it into the public semantic API.
patches.removalCondition: Remove when the supported official Creator version treats missing mask_threshold as optional, or when pinned upstream emits an equivalent backward-compatible Part field itself.

patches.reason: Official Inochi Creator v0.8.6 deserializes Part.blend_mode through the legacy enum string keys (Normal, Multiply, Screen, etc.), while pinned Inochi2D v0.8.7 changed BlendMode to explicit uint values and serializes the integral value. After restoring the required mask_threshold field, Creator reaches blend_mode and rejects the numeric representation. Emit the legacy string key while retaining v0.8.7 loader support for both string and numeric inputs.
patches.removalCondition: Remove when the supported official Creator version consumes numeric v0.8.7 blend modes directly, or when pinned upstream emits a backward-compatible blend-mode representation itself.

patches.reason: Official Inochi Creator v0.8.6 deserializes Parameter.merge_mode through legacy enum string keys (Additive, Weighted, Multiplicative, Forced, Passthrough), while pinned v0.8.7's generic serde treats ParamMergeMode as an integral scalar and emits a number. The Creator acceptance ladder proves visual puppets open but the first unbound-parameter puppet fails, isolating the incompatibility to parameter serialization before bindings are present. Emit the legacy string key without changing the public semantic API.
patches.removalCondition: Remove when the supported official Creator version consumes numeric v0.8.7 parameter merge modes directly, or when pinned upstream emits a backward-compatible ParamMergeMode representation itself.

patches.reason: Official Inochi Creator v0.8.6 opens the same real puppet through unbound parameters but fails only once ValueParameterBinding records are present. Its binding schema deserializes interpolate_mode through legacy enum strings, while pinned v0.8.7 stores InterpolateMode as an explicit uint and emits that numeric value. Emit the legacy interpolation key without exposing any compatibility detail through the public semantic API.
patches.removalCondition: Remove when the supported official Creator version consumes numeric v0.8.7 binding interpolation modes directly, or when pinned upstream emits a backward-compatible InterpolateMode representation itself.

patches.reason: Pinned Inochi2D v0.8.7 allocates MeshDeformer base/deformed runtime meshes only during deserialization, so a freshly authored MeshDeformer created through the public constructor crashes when assigning its first mesh. Lazily initialize those runtime buffers in the mesh setter so standard semantic authoring can create a real mesh deformer without a private side rig.
patches.removalCondition: Remove when the pinned upstream revision can construct a fresh MeshDeformer and assign MeshDeformer.mesh safely without this initialization patch.
